description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to volume operations in Kubernetes, including error types, operation execution, and identifiers for volumes and pods.

classes.name: GeneratedOperations
classes.description: Contains operation details and functions for executing volume operations.

classes.name: OperationContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a volume operation, including errors and migration status.

classes.name: FailedPrecondition
classes.description: Represents a precondition failure error in volume operations.

classes.name: InfeasibleError
classes.description: Indicates that a volume operation is not feasible in the current state.

classes.name: TransientOperationFailure
classes.description: Represents a transient failure during a volume operation.

classes.name: UncertainProgressError
classes.description: Indicates an operation may still be in progress or in an uncertain state.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the volume operation and supporting functions, handling panics and errors.

methods.name: NewOperationContext
methods.description: Creates a new OperationContext with specified errors and migration status.

methods.name: NewFailedPreconditionError
methods.description: Creates a new FailedPrecondition error instance.

methods.name: IsFailedPreconditionError
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type FailedPrecondition.

methods.name: IsInfeasibleError
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type InfeasibleError.

methods.name: IsOperationNotSupportedError
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type OperationNotSupported.

methods.name: IsOperationFinishedError
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates a finished operation.

methods.name: IsFilesystemMismatchError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a filesystem mismatch mount error.

methods.name: IsUncertainProgressError
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type UncertainProgressError.
